text: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch,
zh: 当埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，
zh_hant: 當埃斯卡洛皮亞大使回家吃午飯時，

text: his wife got a shock.
He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服糟透了。
zh_hant: 他臉色蒼白，衣服糟透了。

text: 'What has happened?'
she asked.
'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
'A fire extinguisher, my dear,'
answered the Ambassador drily.
'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
zh: “今天早上大学生放火烧了大使馆。”
zh_hant: “今天早上大學生放火燒了大使館。”

text: 'Good heavens!'
exclaimed his wife.
'And where were you at the time?'
'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
zh: “我和平常一样在办公室里，”大使回答。
zh_hant: “我和平常一樣在辦公室裡，”大使回答。

text: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
zh: 火是从地下室烧起来的。
zh_hant: 火是從地下室燒起來的。

text: I went down immediately, of course,
and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
zh: 那个笨蛋霍斯特把灭火器对准我喷。
zh_hant: 那個笨蛋霍斯特把滅火器對準我噴。

text: He thought I was on fire.
I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
zh: 我一定要把那个家伙调走。
zh_hant: 我一定要把那個傢伙調走。

text: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
zh: 大使的妻子继续问问题，
zh_hant: 大使的妻子繼續問問題，

text: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
zh: 这时她突然注意到丈夫帽子上有个大洞。
zh_hant: 這時她突然注意到丈夫帽子上有個大洞。

text: 'And how can you explain that?'
she asked.
'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
zh: “有人朝我办公室窗户开了一枪。
zh_hant: “有人朝我辦公室窗戶開了一槍。

text: Accurate, don't you think?
Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
zh: 幸运的是，我当时没戴着帽子。
zh_hant: 幸運的是，我當時沒戴著帽子。

text: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
zh: 要是我戴着，我就没法回家吃午饭了。
zh_hant: 要是我戴著，我就沒法回家吃午飯了。
